label: consistent

said.text: In the face of Republicans’ complete failure to govern, I introduced the RAISE Act to put commonsense safeguards around AI so that it actually makes people’s lives better instead of putting them at risk. It’s not anti-innovation; it makes our country’s AI industry stronger, safer and better for everyone.

did.text: Voted Yes on S6954-B, the Stop Deepfakes Act, requiring providers of synthetic-content systems to include provenance data on AI-generated content. Passed Senate 60–1.

whyNote: The statement, made in response to a federal executive order on state AI regulation, argues for state-level AI safeguards and cites a different bill (the RAISE Act), not this one. The vote passed a separate state AI measure he also sponsors; the label reflects alignment between the general position stated and this vote.
